verdict.rationale: Evidence covers pricing tiers (event/metric volume caps) and general trigger/SLO alerting on telemetry data, but there is no documentation of a cost/usage dashboard, per-team or per-service spend attribution, or alerts specifically tied to usage/billing spikes. Community comments even raise concern that certain patterns can '10x your observability costs' without any counter-evidence of built-in spend visibility tooling to catch this.
